items.text: Before there were TV and movies, there was vaudeville , a type of theater that entertained people. Back then, entertainers wanted to be sure that their shows would be enjoyable everywhere. This is true today but for all across the world. Parrot Analytics, an analytics company, called this idea “ travelability ” if a TV show is popular globally. The USA is famous for its TV shows, but Parrot Analytics says that the country that makes the most shows with “travealabiltiy” is Canada. The show genres that have done the best are dramas and children’s programs and are in English. English content is important because most people do not want content in other languages or with subtitles. Originally, Americans made shows in Canada, but more Canadian shows have won awards recently. Canadian companies now are making more and more of their own shows. Difficult words: vaudeville (a type of theater with dancing, singing, and comedy acts), “ travelabiltiy ” (the idea that something can be popular very far away), genre (a type of story such as drama, comedy, science fiction, horror, romance, or nonfiction). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In the past, theater entertainers wanted their work to be popular to all people. With TV shows and movies, companies want their work to be popular all across the world. The USA is famous for its TV shows, but an analytics company saw that Canada makes the most shows that are the most globally famous. The genres that are the most popular are drama and children’s programs. These shows are also in English, as many people like if they are in English and do not have subtitles . Originally, Americans made shows in Canada. Now more Canadian shows are winning awards. Canadian companies are making more of their own shows. Difficult words: analytics (when you analyze or study something to find out information about it), genre (a type of story like drama, comedy, science fiction, horror, romance, or nonfiction), subtitle (words on the TV show or theater screen that show you what another person is speaking). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Entertainers perform in theaters in the past. They want all people to like their work. Today people make TV shows and movies. Companies want all people in the world to like their work. The USA is famous for its TV shows. However, a company says that Canada makes the most popular shows in the world. People like drama stories and children’s programs the best. These shows are also in English. Many people want to see shows in English. Originally, American companies go to Canada to make TV shows. Now more Canadian shows win awards. Canadian companies make more of their own shows. Difficult words: entertainer (a person who sings, dances, acts, or does other fun activities for people to watch), perform (sing, dance, act, or do other work in front of other people), theater (a theater is a place for plays, dancing, singing, comedy, speeches, and also movies). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Recently, Afghanistan held its presidential election, but there were problems and around 20% of registered votes came to vote. People were afraid to vote because of Taliban threats. One voting official said that 68 Taliban attacks happened during the voting, killing at least five people and hurting dozens . There were also problems with identifying voters through biometric identification , hostile election workers, and incomplete lists of voters. Now that 20% of Afghanistan’s voters will decide the next president. The main candidates are the current president, Ashraf Ghani, and his chief executive, Abdullah Abdullah. People will find out the results in November. Difficult words: dozens (more than 24), biometric identification (using your body features to identify you, such as your eyes, fingerprints, or voice), hostile (angry). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Afghanistan held its presidential election. There were problems with the voter turnout because around 20% of registered votes came to vote. People were afraid to vote because of Taliban threats . One voting official said that 68 Taliban attacks happened during the voting, killing at least five people and hurting more. There were also problems with identifying voters, angry election workers, and incomplete lists of voters. Now 20% of Afghanistan’s voters are going to decide the next president. The main candidates are the current president and his chief executive . People are going to find out the results in November. Difficult words: voter turnout (how many people come vote), threat (when someone says he is going to hurt or kill you), chief executive (a leader who helps the president do his job). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Afghanistan has presidential elections . Few people come to vote . Only 20% of registered voters come. People do not vote because of the Taliban. They are afraid that they will hurt or kill them. An election official says that the Taliban makes 68 attacks during the voting. Five people die and more people get hurt. Other problems happen. Some voters cannot prove who they are. Some election workers are mean. Some lists of voters are not complete. 20% of Afghanistan’s voters are going to choose the president. People find out who they choose in November. Difficult words: election (when people elect or choose the leader of a place), vote (tell who you want to be a leader), registered voter (a person who signs up to vote). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

At the Frankfurt Motor Show, car company Porsche demonstrated its first fully electric sports car called the Taycan. It is a direct competitor to the Tesla Model S. CEO Oliver Blume explained that the car can drive very fast and complete the Nurburgring in 7 minutes and 42 seconds. He presented that it can run about 300 miles while it carries luggage. He also said that the battery can charge from 5% to 80% in 22 minutes with quick-charging technology. Difficult words: Nurburgring (a race track in Germany), a direct competitor (a product that competes with a similar product for people to buy it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Recently, car company Porsche showed its first fully electric sports car called the Taycan. It is competition to the Tesla Model S. Porsche’s CEO explained that the car drives very fast and completed a race track in less than 8 minutes. He said that the car runs about 300 miles while it carries luggage. He added that the battery charges from 5% to 80% in 22 minutes with quick-charging technology. Difficult words: competition (when people or companies work to get someone’s attention to buy something), sports car (a car which people can drive as their daily car, but the car can drive very fast and work very well), quick-charging (a way to charge batteries very fast). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Porsche is a car company. It makes a fully electric sports car . The car’s name is the Taycan. This car is a competitor to the Tesla Model S . Porsche shows the Taycan. The CEO talks about the car. He says that the car goes very fast. It finishes a race track in less than 8 minutes. He says that the car goes very far. It runs about 300 miles while it has luggage inside. He also says that the car battery charges very fast. It charges from 5% to 80% in 22 minutes. Difficult words: sports car (a car which drives very fast and works very well), competitor (a person or company that works to get someone’s attention to buy something), Tesla Model S (Tesla is another car company that makes electric cars and the Model S is one of its cars). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Since the famous Barbie doll first appeared in 1959, it has changed styles, but its body shape was always too perfect. People accused its maker, Mattel, of promoting a beauty standard which was unrealistic. However, now Mattel has decided to offer a diversified line of dolls that are gender – inclusive . Kids can choose the gender and personalize their dolls. They can choose the colour of hair, the color of skin, the clothing, and the accessories. Some options are more feminine and others are more masculine. Mattel also changed Barbie’s boyfriend, Ken, and created a doll with a prosthetic leg and another in a wheelchair. The doll’s price is $30.00. Mattel worked with doctors, parents and kids to create a doll “free of labels” and to be more natural. Difficult words: diversified (including a wide variety of things), gender-inclusive (allowing more choices than just “boy” or “girl”), prosthetic (an artificial replacement for a body part). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Mattel created the Barbie doll in 1959. Over the years, it has changed styles, but its body shape was too perfect. People said that Mattel pushed an unrealistic beauty standard . However, now Mattel has new and very different dolls. Kids can choose their doll’s gender , hair color, skin color, clothing, and accessories. They can choose how masculine or feminine their doll is. Mattel also changed Ken, Barbie’s boyfriend, and created a doll with a fake leg and a doll in a wheelchair. Difficult words: beauty standard (what people think is beautiful), gender (male/man, female/woman, or something else), masculine or feminine (how much like a man or a woman something or someone is). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 1959, Mattel makes the Barbie doll. The Barbie doll has many styles . However, its body shape is too skinny. People say that Barbie makes children think they need to be skinny. However, Mattel makes a new and very different line of dolls. Children can pick if the doll is a boy, a girl, or something else. They can pick its hair and skin colors. They can pick its clothing and accessories . Mattel also makes a doll with a fake leg. It also makes a doll in a wheelchair. Mattel says that it works with doctors, parents, and children. They help Mattel make a more realistic doll. Difficult words: style (how someone dresses or looks), line (things that a business sells), accessories (personal objects like purses, backpacks, watches, or jewelry). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Amazon is working on rules about technology which can recognize a person’s face. Amazon’s CEO, Jeff Bezos, says that his team is working on these rules that he wants to present to Congress. Bezos believes that facial recognition has many benefits, but there is also danger that it can be abused . Critics worry that the technology could lead to discrimination and violation of human rights . In February, Amazon released rules for the new technology which could become a part of federal legislation. The technology must protect civil rights and all activities must be transparent. Difficult words: abuse (use for a bad purpose), discrimination (saying that someone is different based on how he looks), violation of human rights (when a person follows rules but cannot live his life in freedom), civil rights (rights that protect you as a person). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

There is technology which recognizes faces, and Amazon wants to regulate this technology. Amazon’s CEO, Jeff Bezos, wants to present the new rules in the US government. He thinks that this technology is good, but it can be dangerous, too. Critics say that people can have unfair treatment because of this technology. Amazon wrote a document that explains some of the problems. Amazon wants to convince lawmakers to make it a part of the country’s laws. It is important that this technology protects people and is transparent . Difficult words: regulate (make rules and laws), convince (make somebody believe something), transparent (clear and understandable). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is technology which can identify human faces. It is controversial . Many people do not like it. The technology can make problems for people. Amazon wants new laws for this technology. The leader of Amazon says that this technology can be very good for people. However, he also says that it can be dangerous. People in Amazon write a special document about some of the problems. They want the technology to be safe for people. They want it to be transparent . Difficult words: identify (say who someone is), controversial (when people have very different opinions about something), transparent (understandable). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

At the beginning of September, someone in Saudi Arabia attacked two major US oil facilities . As a result, the American government decided to send military equipment, radar units, and 200 military troops there. The American Secretary of State, Mike Pompeo, said that these attacks are an “act of war.” President Donald Trump wrote on a social network that the U.S. is ready to respond to any further attack. Yemeni Houthi rebels admitted their responsibility for the attacks. However, the US and other countries believe that Iran is the one responsible for the attacks. Iran says that they have nothing to do with it. The Trump government wants to keep its military assistance defensive . The Defense Secretary, Mark Esper, said that the government can send more military support such as missiles and missile systems. Difficult words: oil facility (a place that creates oil), troops (soldiers), defensive (defend or protect). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In early September, someone attacks two important oil locations for the US in Saudi Arabia. In response, the American government sends military equipment , technology, and 200 soldiers there. One American leader says that the attacks are “an act of war.” Donald Trump writes that the country is going to do something if there is another attack. Yemeni Houthi rebels say that they attacked the locations. However, the US and other countries say that Iran is responsible. Iran says that it is not. The Trump administration wants to keep the military help for defense. Difficult words: military (relating to the armies of a country), equipment (tools, vehicles, and other supplies), administration (a government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US has important oil buildings in Saudi Arabia. Someone attacks two of them. The American government does not like this. It sends equipment , technology, and 200 soldiers there. Yemeni Houthi rebels say that they attacked the buildings. However, the US and other countries say that Iran is responsible . Iran says that it is not. The Trump government says that the military help is for defense . It can send rockets if they need more defense. Difficult words: oil (a dark liquid that comes from the ground and people turn it into gasoline and other important things), equipment (things that help people do their jobs or help them live), Yemeni Houthi rebels (people who come from Yemen who fight against other governments). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Typhoon Tapah hit southern Japan and Okinawa with rain and winds up to 100 miles per hour. It threw and damaged car windows, knocked down structures and signs, and flooded areas. After the intense event and chaos , the storm is heading to the main island of Japan. Forecasters say that there will be more rain, flooding, and landslides. Difficult words: typhoon (a large storm that starts over the ocean and goes to land), intense (strong, extreme), chaos (when a lot of things happen at one time). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Typhoon Tapah hit southern Japan and Okinawa with rain and very high winds. It threw and broke cars windows, knocked down structures , and flooded places. Now the typhoon is going to the main island of Japan. Experts say that there will be more rain, flooding, and landslides . Difficult words: typhoon (a very big storm that starts on the ocean and goes to land) , structure (a building or other object a person builds), landslide (when too much water goes into the ground and makes the ground move). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Typhoon Tapah goes to Okinawa, Japan. It rains a lot. It has very strong winds. The winds throw cars. The winds break car windows. The winds knock down small buildings. There is a lot of flooding . Now the typhoon goes to the big island of Japan. Experts talk about the typhoon. They say that there will be more rain, flooding, and landslides . Difficult words: typhoon (a big storm that is over the ocean and then it goes to the land) , flooding (a lot of water), landslide (when water goes in the ground and the water makes the ground move). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There has been an outbreak of measles in Congo which has already killed 3,500 people this year. This is a lot more than during the epidemic of Ebola. There are mostly children among the dead. The Congolese government and the World Health Organization (WHO) have a plan to vaccinate hundreds of thousands of children who are younger than five years old. The WHO announced the third campaign this year as an emergency situation. Over 180,000 people may suffer from measles in Congo. According to the WHO, this is the largest and fastest-moving measles epidemic in the last ten years. The number of global reported cases almost tripled compared with 2018. Difficult words: outbreak (when a disease happens suddenly and many people catch the disease), epidemic (when a lot of people are sick from a disease), vaccinate (give medicine to stop a disease). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Congo, many people are sick from measles which is a very deadly disease. This year, more than 3,500 children died from measles. This is more than during the epidemic of Ebola . An organization says that this new epidemic is very big and it spreads fast. There have been over 180,000 cases in Congo this year. The government is quickly helping. The plan is to give medicine to almost 825,000 young children. In 2018, there were 129,000 cases of measles in the world. In 2019, there have been more than 360,000 cases which is much more than last year. Difficult words: measles (a sickness that makes you weak and puts spots on your body), epidemic (when many people are sick from a disease), Ebola (a sickness that makes you bleed inside your body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are many sick people in Congo. Most of them are children. They have a sickness called measles. It is a very dangerous disease . It kills a lot of people. The government in Congo and an organization want to help. They want to give medicine to many children. They have to work very fast. The measles disease makes many people sick. Many more people get sick quickly. Last year, almost 130,000 people are sick because of measles. This year, almost 364,000 people are sick. Difficult words: disease (a serious sickness), government (the leaders of a place). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last Monday, four EU countries agreed on a new deal to distribute migrants recovered from the Mediterranean Sea. Interior ministers from France, Germany, Italy and Malta approved the deal. Finland, which currently holds the EU presidency, helped broker the deal. Under the new agreement, EU countries would volunteer to take in migrants rescued in the Mediterranean within weeks of their arrival. The countries would also handle asylum requests. The deal aims to ease pressure on southern EU countries like Italy and Malta that see hundreds of thousands of migrants arrive on their shores every year and have complained that other EU countries do not help out. More details about the plan are going to be revealed to all 28 EU nations on October 8th. It is still not clear how many other EU countries will participate in the proposal. Difficult words: approve (say “yes” to something), broker (arrange), volunteer (offer to do something without getting anything for it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Hundreds of thousands of migrants arrive on the shores of southern EU countries like Italy and Malta every year. These countries complained that other EU members do not help out. A new plan could help ease the problem. France, Germany, Italy and Malta approved the plan last Monday. Under the new plan, EU countries would volunteer to take in migrants saved from the Mediterranean Sea. The countries would help them within weeks after the migrants get to Europe. Details about the new plan are not yet known. More information is going to be shared with all 28 EU countries on October 8th. Difficult words: shore (the line where the sea meets the land), approve (say “yes” to something), volunteer (offer to do something because you want to do it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People are coming to Europe. They come from other countries. They want to live in Europe. They are called migrants. They move to Europe because of war in their home country, for example. Many migrants sail across the Mediterranean Sea. They sail to southern EU countries. These are countries like Italy and Malta. Hundreds of thousands of migrants come to these countries every year. The southern countries ask the EU for help. France, Germany, Italy and Malta meet to discuss this. They think of a plan. When the plan comes to be , EU countries can help these southern countries help the migrants. We do not have more information about the plan at the moment. Everything is going to be said on October 8th. Difficult words: sail (go on a boat), come to be (the countries start to do things which are on the plan), is going to (in the future). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Earlier this month, Prime Minister Boris Johnson suspended the British parliament, insisting that the five-week suspension was necessary to get ready for a new parliamentary session. However, the justices decided that the suspension was unlawful and that Johnson broke the law because his suspension left lawmakers unable to act, especially when the deadline of Brexit is on October 31st. On Wednesday September 25th, Johnson arrived back in the UK, cutting his trip to the United Nations General Assembly short. The British parliament is back in business . Critics are calling upon Johnson to resign from his post, but he is currently refusing to do this. Difficult words: suspend (stop), insist (strongly say), justice (a judge of the Supreme Court of a country), be back in business (start something again). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Earlier this month, Prime Minister Boris Johnson suspended the British parliament. He said that he had to do it to get ready for a new parliamentary session . For five weeks, nobody worked in the parliament. However, the justices later said that Johnson broke the law. The parliament went back to work on Wednesday, September 25th. Critics are calling upon Johnson to resign. Difficult words: suspend (stop), parliamentary session (a longer time when the parliament regularly meets), justice (a judge of the Supreme Court of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This news is from the UK. Boris Johnson suspends the British parliament this month. The MP s do not work for five weeks. However, the Supreme Court says that Johnson cannot suspend the parliament. They say that it is a crime. The Supreme Court says that the parliament must go back to work. MPs start work again on Wednesday, September 25th. Critics say that Johnson should stop being prime minister. Difficult words: suspend (stop), MP (a member of parliament – the UK government), Supreme Court (the highest court in the UK – the lawyers with the most power). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The 186 th Oktoberfest is officially under way . The mayor of Munich opened the annual event, and the first glass of beer was filled. Millions of party lovers from across the globe travel to Munich each September to visit the world’s most famous beer festival. People expect that more than 7 million litres of beer will be consumed during the 15-day event. People can enjoy the festival in 38 big tents. They can also take part in some historical tours. Difficult words: under way (happening now), mayor (boss of a city), annual (happening every year), take part in (to be present at some event). You can watch the original video news lower on this page.

The Oktoberfest for 2019 started. The mayor of Munich opened the festival, and the first glass of beer was filled . Millions of party lovers travel to Munich each September and they visit the most famous beer festival. People will drink more than 7 million litres of beer this year. The festival is 15 days long. People can enjoy the festival in 38 big tents. They can also visit some historical tours . Difficult words: mayor (the boss of a city), fill (put water or beer or a liquid into a glass until it is full), tour (an enjoyable journal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Oktoberfest for 2019 is here. The Oktoberfest is a beer festival. People go to Munich every year in September when the festival starts. They drink beer. They speak with other people. The festival is a big party. People can drink 7 million litres of beer this year. The festival is 15 days long. People can visit 38 big tents . They can also visit some historical tours . Difficult words: tent (a small “house” for camping), historical (from the past), tour (an interesting journey). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Central Park Tower has just become the tallest residential building in the word. The views from this building are amazing. The prices in this skyscraper are as high as the sky . The cheapest apartment starts at 6.7 million dollars, and the most expensive five-bedroom apartment costs 63 million dollars. It cost 3 billion dollars to build this tower. The question is who will buy the apartments now when there are few new buyers looking for expensive apartments in New York. Difficult words: residential (only for people with no offices), skyscraper (a very tall building). You can watch the original video news lower on this page.

Central Park Tower is a building in New York with apartments only. There are no offices in this building. It is now the tallest building with apartments in the world, and the views from this building are fantastic. The prices in this building are very high. The cheapest apartments start at 6.7 million dollars. The most expensive five-bedroom apartment costs 63 million dollars. It cost 3 billion dollars to build this tower. The question is who will buy the apartments now when there are not many new buyers who are looking for expensive apartments in New York. Difficult words: tower (a very tall building), view (what you see). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Central Park Tower is a building in New York. There are only apartments in this building. There are no offices in this building. Now it is the tallest building with apartments in the world. The views from this building are fantastic . The prices in this building are very high. The prices start at 6.7 million dollars for one apartment. The most expensive apartment costs 63 million dollars. People don’t know who will buy these expensive flats. There are not many new customers who are looking for expensive apartments in New York. Difficult words: tower (a tall building), view (what you see), fantastic (very good, amazing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

American leaders have different opinions on how the US should participate in world affairs . President Barack Obama said that isolationism was not an option. President Bush said that helping others showed the strength and generosity of the country. President Trump said that it was up to other people to decide their future. However, a survey of the American public showed that 7 in 10 Americans think that the country needs to be more involved in world affairs. They think that America should work on world trade, help others, protect democracy and human rights, defend allies , and by doing so, keep the country safe. The survey said that 3 of 10 Americans want America to be involved in the world but with certain activities. They want the country to help with trade and diplomacy instead of military support. Difficult words: world affairs (events that happen across the world), isolationism (when a country does not work with other countries), ally (a partner in war). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

American leaders feel differently about how the US participates in the world. President Obama and President Bush said that it was good for America to work with others. President Trump said that other countries need to decide their future without the USA. However, a survey of the American public shows that 7 of 10 people think that the country needs to do more throughout the world. They think that the USA needs to be part of world trade, help others, protect democracy and people, defend countries, who are friends to America, and keep America safe. Three of ten people said that America needs to be part of world trade and diplomacy only. Difficult words: participate (do something, take part), public (the people), diplomacy (the talks between countries, not fighting). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

American leaders have different opinions on what the USA does in the world. President Obama and President Bush say that it is good for America to be active in the world. President Trump says that other countries need to work on their own. A survey of the American people shows what they think. Most people want America to be active throughout the world. They want the USA to be in world trade, help others, protect democracy and people, defend countries, and keep America safe. Some people want America to work on world trade and world talks only (without being part of wars). Difficult words: opinion (an idea about something such as if it is good or bad), survey (when you ask many people what they think about something), democracy (a type of government where people pick their leaders). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US updated its tariffs on Chinese goods set for October 1st. In response, China is exempting some American goods from harsh tariffs, such as pork and soybeans. These moves are calming people in the trade war between the US and China. The choice to exempt soybeans is important because they make America a lot of money. A US government agency says that soybeans are about half of the main crops in the US, and they bring in about 30% of US crop value . In similar timing, a Chinese business bought more than 600,000 tons of soybeans from the US. Difficult words: tariff (a tax on imports and exports), exempt (leave out), crop value (the money a farmer or an organization makes when they sell plants or animals). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US changed its tariffs for Chinese goods set for October 1st. In response, China is removing some American goods from its punitive tariffs, such as pork and soybeans. These changes are calming people in the trade war between the US and China. The choice to remove soybeans from tariffs is important because they are a US cash crop . A US government agency says that soybeans are half of the main crops in the US. They also bring in about 30% of the money for crops in the US. Difficult words: tariff (the money you must pay to the government on imports and exports), punitive (harsh, difficult), cash crop (something which a farmer or an organization sells that makes a lot of money). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A tariff is a special fee . Countries make other countries pay tariffs when they sell or buy things. Right now, there is a trade war with the US and China. The US changes its tariffs for China. Next China changes its tariffs. They remove some American goods from the tariffs. These are goods like pork and soybeans. This makes people feel calmer about the trade war. China picks soybeans because they are important to the US. The US says that soybeans are about half of the American important crops . Soybeans also make up about 30% of money for crops from the USA. Difficult words: fee (the money which you have to pay), trade war (when two countries change how they sell or buy things to make others change how they sell or buy), goods (things), crop (a plant or animal that you grow and sell for money). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last Wednesday, India completely banned e-cigarettes saying that they are a massive health risk, especially among young adults and children. India’s finance minister said that e-cigarettes were initially promoted as a way to get people to quit smoking, but reports show that people are instead becoming addicted to them. India’s government said that the use of e-cigarettes has recently gone up extremely high in developed countries and because of what seems like an epidemic. The production, import, export, transport, sale, storage, and advertisement relating to e-cigarettes are now all banned in India. People who violate the ban for the first time can face up to a year in prison, pay a fine of more than $1,300, or both. Difficult words: initially (in the beginning), promote (make something more popular), violate (break). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last Wednesday, India completely banned e-cigarettes. The government says that it is a great health risk especially among young people and children. India’s finance minister said that e-cigarettes were promoted as a way to get people to quit smoking, but reports show that people become addicted to them instead. The Indian government says that the use of e-cigarettes is extremely high in some countries – so much so that it is an epidemic. The ban in India covers everything: the production, import, export, transport, sale and storage . If you break the ban, you can go to prison for up to a year, pay $1,300, or both. Difficult words: promote (make something more popular), addicted (when you cannot stop doing something even if it is bad for you), storage (storing something – having it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

India bans e-cigarettes. You cannot make, move or sell e-cigarettes there. If you break the ban, you can go to prison for up to one year. The Indian government says why they do this. They say that people are getting addicted to e-cigarettes. They say that there are e-cigarette epidemics in some countries. They do not want this to happen in India. They say that e-cigarettes are dangerous. They are especially dangerous to young people and children. Difficult words: ban (make something illegal), addicted (when you cannot stop doing something and it is bad for you), epidemic (when many people are in danger because of a drug, virus, or a thing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists studying data from the Hubble Space Telescope discovered water vapor in the atmosphere of a distant exoplanet . The planet named K2-18b is 111 light years away and it is the first one with water to exist in its star’s habitable zone , which makes it a perfect candidate to search for alien life. The next step is going to be to detect chemicals in the planet’s atmosphere, which is going to take place within the next 10 years, according to the study’s lead scientist. These chemicals could indicate whether anything lives on the planet. Difficult words: vapor (a fog), exoplanet (a planet which orbits a star other than the sun), habitable zone (the area from the star which is neither too hot nor too cold for water/life). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Scientists discovered water vapor in the atmosphere of a distant exoplanet . The planet named K2-18b is 111 light years away. It is the first exoplanet with water to exist near its star’s livable area, which makes it a perfect candidate to search for alien life. The next step is going to be to detect chemicals around the planet. That will be possible within the next 10 years. These chemicals could show if anything lives on the planet.
